title: Cas A · Chandra RGB (Draft)
description: The same plan as Drafts only: a start Card and three Drafts that state what each step takes and gives, ready for the Agent's "Generate Cards".

cards.summary: Fetch the primary-processed event file of a Chandra observation of Cas A, pinned with Nix, and pass the unpacked FITS to the next Card. The file is taken from HEASARC's mirror ftp://heasarc.gsfc.nasa.gov/chandra/data/byobsid/<last digit of the ObsID>/<ObsID>/primary/<file> over explicit FTPS (ftp:// with --ssl-reqd), with its content pinned by hash. Nix does the fetching and unpacking in the Card's default.nix; the download happens only the first time, and later runs use the file in the store as it is (no network while running). ObsID, file name and hash are parameters read from default.nix, with ObsID 25628 as the default. Available observations: ObsID 25628 (acisf25628N002_evt2.fits.gz, sha256-MYAMIQXv/cwAV6L30N5+XODCrCSYk6NTqpMV+VSDwp4=, 2.1 ks, 13 MB), ObsID 114 (acisf00114N006_evt2.fits.gz, sha256-l7CCu8BibZmfu8QyVF5yC7OQjkrwbnkW5AvWlWcyK/Y=, 2000, 50 ks, 520 MB), ObsID 19606 (acisf19606N002_evt2.fits.gz, sha256-FPE5ByrHvbx0Cxk5wVu/N8kjZCrsiFy5snxV1Ypcvtc=, 2019, 49 ks, 349 MB). Pass the path of the file in the store, the ObsID and the hash to the next Card. Log the source URL, the hash and the size after unpacking.

cards.summary: Use x, y and energy (eV) of EVENTS and split them into three non-overlapping bands, 600–1650 / 1650–2250 / 2250–7500 eV (only the last band includes its upper edge). The grid is 360×360 at a step of 2 pixels, centred on the centre of Cas A (RA 350.8584°, Dec +58.8113°) converted to sky pixels with the coordinates of the event file's x, y columns (TCRVL, TCRPX, TCDLT, a tangent-plane projection; the centre differs by observation). Save each band as FITS. Make the band edges and the grid size parameters. Assert that the number of photons counted equals the number of events selected, and show the photons per band as a table.

cards.summary: Assign the three band images, at the same coordinates and size, to R, G and B and make a PNG stretched with asinh (the stretch's percentile 99.5 and q=10 are parameters). No exposure correction. Record the display conditions and the hash of the input, and show the PNG.

notes.html: Plan of the analysis / Cas A (Chandra) Make a three-colour image from public event data. The observation is pinned with Nix; changing the ObsID switches between a short calibration observation (25628) and deep observations (114 from 2000, 19606 from 2019)

intro: A Draft is a Card that says in words what it receives, what it does and what it passes on. It has no code yet. With "Generate Cards" in the app, the Agent writes code from these words, runs it and checks.
